metadata.title: Opindx replication: Open Journal Factor, Network Factor and Article Network Score
metadata.description: Reproducible journal metrics from downloaded OpenAlex Works/Sources Parquet snapshots and the Norwegian Register. Includes the independent OJF two-year count workflow, raw/filtered scores, NF/ANS citation-network calculations, reviewed identity corrections, field metadata, complete annual CSV/XLSX/Parquet export, and the corresponding website and percentile engine. No licensed benchmark data, commercial roster, benchmark matches or empirical comparison outputs are bundled. Version 0.4.0 adds OJF; prior NF/ANS data and frozen-year pins remain unchanged. Validation includes the recorded NF/ANS baseline replay, exact OJF frozen-count replay for all five years, source metadata matching and all-cell export checks; no new full raw-snapshot replay was performed for this additive release.
